class.name: ViewModel
class.brief_description: Base class for MVVM view models.
class.description:
ViewModel holds a map of named [ObservableProperty] values. GDScript subclasses add business logic and command methods. Properties are created lazily on first access.
Use subscript syntax ([code]self["key"][/code]) to read/write properties — this routes through the C++ [code]_set[/code]/[code]_get[/code] overrides and triggers [ObservableProperty] change notifications:
[codeblock] extends ViewModel func _init(): self["counter"] = 0 self["title"] = "Hello"
func on_increment(): self["counter"] = self["counter"] + 1 # UI auto-updates via BindingEngine [/codeblock]
Bind to UI nodes with [method Context.bind_property] and [method Context.bind_command]. Call [method dispose] in [method Activity._on_destroy] to release all property subscribers.

method.name: dispose
method.description: Releases all [ObservableProperty] instances, disconnecting all subscribers. Call this in [method Activity._on_destroy].

method.name: get_property
method.description: Returns the [ObservableProperty] named [param name], creating it if it doesn't exist.

method.name: get_property_names
method.description: Returns the names of all currently tracked properties.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the current value of the named property. Returns [code]null[/code] if the property does not exist.

method.name: has_property
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a property with [param name] has been created.

method.name: set_property
method.description: Sets the value of the named property. Creates it if it doesn't exist. If the value changes, all subscribers (e.g. UI bindings) are notified.

method.name: subscribe_property
method.description: Subscribes a callback to value changes of the named property. The callback receives the new value as its argument.
